name: Pango
source:
A round, gelatinous creature, the pango seeks out all things crystal and magical, so it is a surprise when he takes an immediate liking to the protagonist. An honorary travel companion for the group, the pango’s innocent and happy nature can melt even the coldest of hearts.

[From official website]
